name: Maria Lopez
message: I'm the founder of a 12-agent real-estate brokerage. Leads from Zillow and our website sit in a shared inbox for hours. We need an automation that qualifies every lead with AI, pushes it into HubSpot with the right agent as owner and pings them on Telegram. Budget around $8k, we want it live within 2 weeks.
